title: REQ · Manifest file lists every asset with schema-valid entries
summary: A manifest.json that passes parseManifest and covers the scene's asset references.
description: Context: parseManifest validates id, path, type, dimensions, frames, animations, origin and bounds. Desired behavior: game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json with version 1, one entry per asset from the folder tree, paths relative to game/public/assets, and ids objects/bed, objects/bookshelf, objects/desk, objects/old-computer, objects/window, objects/door matching bedroom.yaml. The boy spritesheet has frames and idle animation. Expected result: parseManifest returns ok.
acceptance_criteria: Given manifest.json, when parseManifest runs, then ok is true
Given bedroom.yaml, when each object asset ref is looked up, then a manifest id exists
Given the boy spritesheet entry, when read, then it has frameCount 2 and an idle animation
